content.comment_body: Hello, I'm looking for a [product_name] unit to replace an old discontinued model. Most units I find appear to support only 12-24VDC input, while my previous unit used a 24VAC supply. Is there a current model available that accepts 24VAC?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is searching for a replacement [product_name] unit that works with a 24VAC supply, since most available options seem to support only DC input. Another user provided an example of a suitable model, showing that units compatible with 24VAC are still available in the current [product_name] series.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to find a [product_name] unit that accepts a 24VAC power supply as a direct replacement for their old device.
